req.title: Cookies-set returns Set-Cookie per entry
req.statement: The system shall emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair passed to /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies/set must emit one Set-Cookie header per k=v pair. The set_cookies() handler iterates request.args and calls r.set_cookie() for each pair, then redirects. Tests must verify: (1) positive — two params yield two Set-Cookie headers with correct names/values; (2) negative — zero params yield zero Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary — exactly one param yields exactly one Set-Cookie header. Additional tests cover exact header count, exact cookie values, and the redirect status code to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
actions: Create Flask test client with allow_redirects=False
expected: Exactly two Set-Cookie headers are present
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: one Set-Cookie per k=v pair
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?a=1&b=2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    joined = ' '.join(set_cookie_headers)
    assert 'a=1' in joined
    assert 'b=2' in joined
    names = [h.split('=')[0].strip() for h in set_cookie_headers]
    assert 'a' in names
    assert 'b' in names

test_cookies_set_two_params_emits_two_set_cookie_headers()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar&baz=qux', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    joined = ' '.join(set_cookie_headers)
    assert 'foo=bar' in joined
    assert 'baz=qux' in joined
    assert 'foo=qux' not in joined
    assert 'baz=bar' not in joined

test_cookies_set_cookie_values_are_exact_not_swapped()

expected: cookies dict has m=10 and n=20
trace: R-HTTPBIN-047: after redirect, cookies are visible at /cookies
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_set_follow_redirect_cookies_visible_in_view():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?m=10&n=20', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['m'] == '10'
    assert data['cookies']['n'] == '20'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 2

test_cookies_set_follow_redirect_cookies_visible_in_view()
